تلتزمين (form VIII)
# تَلْتَزِمِينَ (taltazimīna) /tal.ta.zi.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# تُلْتَزَمِينَ (tultazamīna) /tul.ta.za.miː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
